summary: Pasqal Holding SA filed a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, furnishing its first-half 2026 financial results press release plus MD&A and unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the periods ended June 30, 2026 and 2025. The French foreign private issuer reported revenue of €4.9 million, up 14% year-over-year, with QPU-related services revenue of €3.9 million, up 34%. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or closing date is stated; this is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. The only structural note is prior completion of the Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II business combination, leaving approximately €312.9 million cash as of August 27, 2026. Watch for post-SPAC lockup expiries, cash burn against the operating loss and Nasdaq trading liquidity rather than deal terms.
